profile.name: Prantik
profile.subtitle: Hi, it's Prantik
paragraphs: I am a web developer specializing in CSS and Java as my primary frontend technologies. I have worked on various projects, including personal websites, e-commerce platforms, and portfolio sites. My goal is to create visually appealing and functional websites that provide an excellent user experience.
In my free time, I enjoy learning new technologies and staying up-to-date with the latest trends in web development. I am always looking for new challenges.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a passionate web developer with a keen eye for aesthetics. I love building beautiful, functional, and user-friendly websites.
